estimand: Fixed-model predicted event-mean video-risk rating change, averaged first across observed events within each held-out participant and then equally across eligible participants; not a causal or crash-probability effect.
model: Five existing participant-held-out LightGBM pipelines. No refitting or tuning. Exact event/stimulus identity and other inputs fixed.

primary.eligible: For each item, same participants for both signs: observed integer baseline and all of baseline/minus1/plus1 within 0..10 and supported. No clamping.

support.unit: Unique training participants from corresponding outer fold only. No outcome information used.
support.distance: Equal-weight Gower over pre-task participant attributes, excluding changed item (23 remaining) or both ACC/LKS items for joint intervention (22 remaining). Scenario/event identity excluded because shared fixed stimuli, not participant support attributes.
support.numeric: Per outer fold, impute missing using unique-training-participant median (0 only for all-missing column), scale absolute distance by training max-minus-min, cap contributions at 1. Constant range: 0 for equal values and 1 for unequal values. Record imputation and training bounds.
support.categorical: 0 if same, 1 if different, missing becomes __missing__ exactly as model. No country hard-match or size threshold.
support.ties: Stable sorted participant_id order, stable nearest-neighbor sort.
support.radius: Held-out d100 must be <= linear-interpolated p95 of training leave-one-person-out d100 using the same excluded-feature distance. Diagonal excluded.
support.local_count: Each original and changed integer value must occur at least min_count times among 100 neighbors; joint uses exact two-item integer pairs at all four corners.
support.too_small: Report coverage and status only; no pooled effect, CI or interpretation.
support.raw_zero: Valid in all six pre-task attitude items.

secondary.dose_eligible: Per item, common support at all five values, primary min_count 10 and radius rule.
secondary.joint: ACC+1,LKS+1, four-corner common support at min_count 10 using joint metric. Difference-in-differences f(both)-f(ACC)-f(LKS)+f(base), plus total and marginal increments.
secondary.by_block: Repeat person-first aggregation within each questionnaire block; secondary pointwise CIs.

bootstrap.sampling: One shared 2000 x all-participant multinomial weight matrix, n=number of participants, equal probabilities. Each eligible-set statistic renormalizes these multiplicities; no isin deduplication.
bootstrap.pointwise: Percentile 2.5/97.5 of finite weighted participant means.
bootstrap.simultaneous_primary: 12 primary pooled item/sign contrasts: bootstrap SE = replicate SD(ddof=1); max across contrasts of abs((replicate-estimate)/SE); linear p95 critical value and estimate +/- critical*SE. Fixed-SE standardized max-deviation bands, not per-replicate studentized/bootstrap-refit intervals.
bootstrap.zero_se: If SE <= 1e-14 and all replicate deviations <= 1e-12, exclude from max statistic and return degenerate interval at estimate; otherwise fail validation.
bootstrap.coverage: Available estimable contrasts included; if any of planned 12 has N<30, report number estimable and label band incomplete, never imply all 12 were estimated.
bootstrap.uncertainty_scope: Conditional on fitted models, realized stimulus library, and frozen support rule; does not include model refit, country-level or stimulus sampling uncertainty.

validation.baseline_first: Before perturbations, reproduce original saved OOF predictions by unique row_key for every fold; abs tolerance 1e-10. Assert participant train/test disjointness and exact row-key sets.
validation.immutability: Compare source and model hashes before and after. Do not alter models, original data, manuscript, or figures.
validation.audit_caches: Save event rows and participant aggregates with original/changed inputs, original/changed predictions, fold, support and boundary flags, and n observed events. Save shared bootstrap weights and participant IDs.

public_reproduction_note: Historical rules retained. Running this code is not prospective preregistration.
